mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases above 2% annualized and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained decline and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 3% annualized, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by less than 0.5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals weakening demand and labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth < 0.5% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth < 0.5% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp, and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows a sustained increase and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.
